items.headline: MV Coromandel exposed at BAB_EL_MANDEB
items.reason: Exposure 0.77 at BAB_EL_MANDEB, propagated from GE-CHOK-e9174376b0.
items.baselineOutcome: Voyage runs to its current ETA on the planned routing.
items.doNothingOutcome: MV Coromandel enters BAB_EL_MANDEB in about 6 h at the current exposure.

recommendedAction.summary: Divert clear of BAB_EL_MANDEB on the alternative routing

effect.statement: about 568 h added to this voyage if the diversion is taken

recommendedAction.tradeoff: Adds passage time; removes the exposure entirely.

alternativeActions.summary: Reduce speed to hold position clear of the area until it reopens
alternativeActions.tradeoff: Keeps the shorter routing and saves fuel, but the delay is open-ended while the event holds.

alternativeActions.summary: Continue as planned and accept the exposure
alternativeActions.tradeoff: No added passage time; the exposure is unchanged.

expectedOperationalEffect.statement: about 568 h added to this voyage if the diversion is taken

items.headline: Bab-el-Mandeb exposure reaching 2 Indian ports
items.reason: 3 trade lanes transit this chokepoint: Europe ↔ India (Suez), Mediterranean ↔ India, US East Coast ↔ India.
items.baselineOutcome: Traffic routes normally through the chokepoint.
items.doNothingOutcome: Exposure propagates to 2 destination ports as arrival bunching.

recommendedAction.summary: Brief affected port authorities on the projected bunching
recommendedAction.tradeoff: Advisory only; the routing decision stays with each carrier.

expectedFinancialEffect.unavailableBecause: this deployment has no a national cost basis configured, so the financial effect is not computed

items.headline: Arrival bunching building at Mundra
items.reason: 277 h of aggregate arrival shift across affected voyages bound here.
items.baselineOutcome: Arrivals berth on their current sequence.
items.doNothingOutcome: Delayed arrivals bunch into the same window and queue at anchor.

recommendedAction.summary: Raise arrival-window advisories to spread the affected calls

effect.statement: yard pressure up 27% against the current capacity index

recommendedAction.tradeoff: Each advisory needs a controller's review before it reaches a master.

alternativeActions.summary: Bring an additional berth or gang onto the affected window
alternativeActions.tradeoff: Uses resource held for scheduled calls.

expectedOperationalEffect.statement: yard pressure up 27% against the current capacity index

expectedFinancialEffect.unavailableBecause: this deployment has no a berth day rate for this port configured, so the financial effect is not computed
